about_the_game:
Still Remember

A game about memory, choices, and what you're willing to leave behind.

Still Remember is a 2D top-down adventure inspired by UNDERTALE, DELTARUNE, and OMORI, with a strong focus on narrative, exploration, and meaningful decisions.

You awaken in the afterlife — a mysterious world divided into layers, each filled with challenges, secrets, and hidden paths. Upon arrival, your memories are taken, and the only way to recover them is to move forward, facing what this world tries to hide from you.

Throughout your journey, you will meet unique and memorable characters — some willing to help, others determined to stop you. Intense battles against enemies and bosses, emotional cutscenes, and a branching narrative lead to multiple endings, making every choice matter.

The world of Still Remember rewards curiosity. Each area features its own identity, side quests, NPCs, and hidden stories, encouraging natural exploration and backtracking.

Character progression is inspired by Elden Ring and other soulslike games, offering deep and strategic upgrades that let you shape your playstyle. Combat is real-time, demanding precision and smart decision-making: knowing when to attack, defend, dodge, or use items can decide victory or defeat.

Exploration truly matters. Along the way, you’ll find unique items with different effects and purposes — some unlock previously inaccessible areas, while others change how you fight or survive.

In the end, Still Remember isn’t just about moving forward, but about what you choose to remember… and what you’re willing to forget.

✦ Key Features

  • Deep branching narrative with multiple endings

  • Real-time combat inspired by soulslike games

  • Rewarding exploration with secrets and backtracking

  • Advanced character progression focused on player choice

  • Layered world design, each with its own identity

  • Emotional atmosphere with memorable music and scenes

  • Unique items that change gameplay and world access
